caseName: Chula Vista City School District v. Bennett
caseNameFull: Chula Vista City School District v. Bennett, Secretary of Education

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Certio-rari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded to the Court of Appeals to transfer the case pursuant to 28 U. S. C. § 1631 to the United States Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit. See 28 U. S. C. § 1295(a)(2).
